glosses: facet, side (of an object with flat, sharply defined surfaces)

examples.en: She was on verge of fainting.

examples.text: Компания моего отца на грани банкротства.
examples.en: My father's company is on the verge of bankruptcy.

examples.text: Я тогда был на грани самоубийства.
examples.en: I was on the verge of killing myself at that time.

examples.text: Любовь и ненависть разделяет тонкая грань.
examples.en: There's a fine line between love and hate.
